name: Satyr Horns
summary: At Splintertree Post, Pixel hires Horde adventurers to gather satyr horns for Ratchet. The traveling goblin sees a chance to trade them in the port town.

sections.title: A Lucrative Opportunity
sections.body: Pixel, a traveling goblin, sees a chance to profit while resting at Splintertree Post. Satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet, and Pixel wants them for the journey back south to the port town. Rather than risk facing the corrupted creatures, Pixel hires passing adventurers to bring back sixteen intact horns.

sections.title: Haunts of the Corrupted
sections.body: Demonic satyrs haunt scattered, fel-tainted ruins across Ashenvale, remnants of their betrayal during the ancient sundering. Hunters can search their strongholds at Night Run, the fortified camp of Satyrnaar, and the shadowed groves of Xavian. Horns gathered from any of these places are the trophies Pixel seeks for Ratchet's merchant wharves.

faq.answer: Pixel is a traveling goblin who stops at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale before heading south to Ratchet, a neutral port.

faq.q: Why does Ratchet want satyr horns?
faq.answer: Pixel says satyr horns fetch a high price in Ratchet, where merchants, alchemists, and collectors of exotic goods pay well for raw demonic reagents and curios from the northern woods.

faq.q: Where can satyr horns be found in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Satyrs haunt tainted places across Ashenvale, including Night Run northwest of Splintertree Post, Satyrnaar just off the main road toward Azshara, and Xavian in northeastern Ashenvale.
Satyrs are ancient night elves corrupted by the Burning Legion thousands of years ago. Now cloven-hoofed and horned, they serve dark powers and corrupt the forest around them.

faq.q: Why is this contract handled at Splintertree Post?
faq.answer: Splintertree Post is the Horde's main fortress in central Ashenvale. Pixel rests there between trade routes and hires nearby Horde warriors already fighting the forest's dangers.

faq.q: Does Pixel have any allegiance to the Horde?
faq.answer: No. Pixel is an independent goblin merchant seeking profit. Like many goblins based around Ratchet, Pixel trades with anyone who can provide valuable goods, regardless of faction politics.

angles.text: Clearing satyr enclaves in central Ashenvale weakens demonic threats to Splintertree Post's fragile supply lines.
Satyrs carry potent fel magic, and their remains interest those who study demonic power.
Tracking demonic humanoids through corrupted woodland ruins like Satyrnaar and Night Run puts your wilderness skills to a dangerous test.
